name: PlatformCodes
title: Health platform codes
description: Codes the platform's engines define: the kinds of engine-native Published Definition carried as a Library, and the modes of an extraction template.

concept.definition: A Library of SDC templates stating which answers on a form become which clinical records.
A Library of the rules that find candidate matches for a patient.
A Library holding an engine-native statechart: the states, steps, timers and decisions of a process.
An extracted resource the form keeps governing: re-extraction versions it, and it is retracted when its answers disappear.
An extracted resource created once from the form, which then lives a life of its own.
